svg.text: ESP32-S3 DevKit + three 1.28” GC9A01 displays. VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, DC and RST are shared; each display has its own CS.
Tip: join the shared lines on a small strip of perfboard (or Wago-style connectors),
then run one wire from there to each display. Button: BOOT (GPIO0). LED: on-board RGB (GPIO48).
